+)
+counter = 0
+
+def _save_obs(obs, label):
+    global counter
+    counter += 1
+    folder = RUNS / f'{counter:03d}_{label}'
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(img)).save(folder / (cam.split(':')[1].split('_')[0] + '.jpg'))
+    (folder / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2, default=str))
+    if obs.proprio is not None:

+
+def observe(seconds=0, label='obs', video='frames'):
+    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
